lines.l: I let it in my eyes
I don't know what to say
And now the bells are ringing
My inspiration flows, can't wait to hear the tune
Around my head it goes a magic melody
You want to sing with me, just la-la-la-la-la
The music is the key and now the lie is gone
Still it goes on and on so deep inside of me
I long to set it free, I don't know what to do
Just can't explain to you, I don't know what to say
Oh not another word, just la-la-la-la
zwischen den Bremer Kreuz und Hemelingen
sechs Kilometer Stop and Go, halbe Stunde mehr.
